title: Extension of homomorphisms into a divisible abelian group
statement: Let $D$ be a divisible abelian group, written additively: for every $d\in D$ and integer $n>0$ there exists $e\in D$ with $ne=d$. Then $D$ is an injective object of the category of abelian groups in the sense of [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Explicitly, for any abelian groups $V,W$, any injective homomorphism $i:V\to W$, and any homomorphism $\chi:V\to D$, there is a homomorphism $\widetilde\chi:W\to D$ satisfying $\widetilde\chi\circ i=\chi$.
